Identity and homelands

Denaakk’e, also called Koyukon, is associated with communities along the Koyukuk and middle Yukon rivers.

Read the sources [1] Alaska Native Language Center

02

Historical context

The Alaska Native Language Center describes Upper, Central, and Lower dialects and the documentation work of Koyukon speaker Eliza Jones.

Read the sources [1] Alaska Native Language Center

03

Living communities and further study

The Alaska Native Language Archive provides a dedicated Koyukon collection. Its records are language evidence, not a substitute for each village government’s perspective.
